description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the AmqpConsumerActor class, which handles AMQP message consumption and processing within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests message handling, header mapping, acknowledgment behavior, and mapping scripts.

classes.name: AmqpConsumerActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the AMQP consumer actor implementation.

methods.name: getConsumerActorProps
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the AmqpConsumerActor with specified mapping actor and payload mapping or acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: getInboundMessage
methods.description: Constructs a test JmsMessage with specified payload and headers for testing message processing.

methods.name: verifyMessageSettlement
methods.description: Verifies that message acknowledgment or failure settlement is properly invoked after processing.

methods.name: testHeaderMapping
methods.description: Test that message headers are correctly mapped to Ditto message headers.

methods.name: plainStringMappingTest
methods.description: Tests that a plain string message is correctly mapped to a ModifyAttribute command with specified scripts.

methods.name: plainStringMappingMultipleTest
methods.description: Tests that multiple mapped commands are correctly generated from a message returning an array via scripts.

methods.name: getJmsMessage
methods.description: Helper to create a JmsMessage with specified payload, correlation ID, and headers for testing.

methods.name: createWithDefaultMapperOnly
methods.description: Test case that verifies message processing with default empty mapping.

methods.name: setupActor
methods.description: Sets up actor instance with optional mapping context for testing.

methods.name: jmsMessageWithNullPropertyAndNullContentTypeTest
methods.description: Test how a message with null application property and content type is handled and mapped to the command.

methods.name: consumerData
methods.description: Utility method to construct ConsumerData object for tests.

methods.name: mockJmsAcknowledgeCallback
methods.description: Creates a mock JmsAcknowledgeCallback that tracks ack status for verification.
